title: Claude Code GTM Agent Starter Pack
description: Open-source starter pack for building AI GTM agents with Claude Code. Designed for growth operators who want to ship AI-native workflows without starting from scratch.
problem: Operators wanted AI-native GTM workflows but had no structured starting point — just blank Claude sessions and scattered prompt tips.
system: 4-layer agent stack: CLAUDE.md operator identity → MCP tools → client memory files → 5 reusable operator skills. Covers research, enrichment, sequence drafting, and CRM updates.
artifact: Open-source GitHub repo with full starter pack — CLAUDE.md template, skill definitions, folder structure, and MCP source.
outcome: Cost per full outbound run: ~$2–8 vs. $200–500/month for an equivalent commercial tool stack.
